page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is allocated 1 vCPU on a shared basis and is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor for virtualization.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for its operating system and data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Additionally, the instance lacks dedicated GPU hardware and does not support advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, AES cryptography, or virtualization extensions, as these flags are disabled or unavailable in this configuration.

Due to its shared CPU allocation and minimal resource footprint, the ecs.s6-c1m2.small offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for lightweight workloads. It is designed for low-intensity tasks that do not require sustained CPU performance or high memory capacity. Suitable workloads include basic web serving, lightweight development or testing environments, simple automation scripts, and low-traffic microservices.
